operation.description:
Gets a deployment branch or tag policy for an environment.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint with a private repository.

#/components/parameters/branch-policy-id.description: The unique identifier of the branch policy.
#/components/parameters/branch-policy-id.name: branch_policy_id

#/components/parameters/environment-name.description: The name of the environment. The name must be URL encoded. For example, any slashes in the name must be replaced with `%2F`.
#/components/parameters/environment-name.name: environment_name

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/deployment-branch-p.description: Details of a deployment branch or tag policy.

id.description: The unique identifier of the branch or tag policy.

name.description: The name pattern that branches or tags must match in order to deploy to the environment.

type.description: Whether this rule targets a branch or tag.

#/components/schemas/deployment-branch-p.title: Deployment branch policy
